$description: Snapshot of a Figma library, written by packages/tokens/scripts/figma/export.js. Don't edit by hand: refresh it from Figma. The drift tests check the token sources and figma.ts against it.

252:521.name: Card Frame
252:521.description: The constant frame (POSTCARDS.md §1). Only the Content Zone changes between cards. Accent rail and tick bind to type/accent: set the instance's Post Type mode to set the type. Series posts show Day and Series ("21 DAYS OF DEV"); regular posts turn both off. Swap Content to a Content/* archetype. Judge at 320px (Thumbnail Test page).

252:574.name: Content/Empty
252:574.description: Default content for Card Frame. Swap the frame's Content property to a Content/* archetype.

266:258.name: Kicker
266:258.description: Post type label. Text is bound to type/label, so it reads the card's Post Type mode; no text property needed.

266:261.name: Check Row

Label.default: Wired the tokens into the site shell

266:261.description: One line of a Ledger or Before / After card. Check (type ink) for shipped, Cross (error) for the mistake, Dot for a note. Struck=Yes is the subtraction ledger, what was cut: the text drops to on-surface-variant and a 3px on-surface-variant strike runs exactly the length of the text, its own layer (.jk-row__strike). Real item names at uneven lengths; 6 rows at most.

266:287.name: Token Chip
266:287.description: A component or token chip for Architecture Diagram zones and Pipeline outputs. Override the swatch fill with the real token.

266:290.name: Arrow
266:290.description: One arrow per card. The annotation carries the rule. A diagram that needs two arrows is two cards.

266:295.name: Equals Badge
266:295.description: The whole argument of a Parity card. Sits on the hairline between the Figma half and the code half.

266:297.name: Terminal
266:297.description: The hero of a Pipeline card: one real command. Content never invents: use the command that actually ran.

266:300.name: Zone Label
266:300.description: Sits on the top edge of a dashed zone (absolute, y = -18). Names the zone: PRIMITIVES, FIGMA, BEFORE…

81:239.name: Content/Manifesto

Statement.default:
One idea per card.
The tweet carries nuance.

81:239.description: Manifesto · best for Principle. One oversized statement; the payoff line sits on a type/accent highlight. No imagery: the type is the image. Break lines by meaning, 3–5 lines at most. Sample copy from postcard-wireframes.jsx.

81:247.name: Content/Architecture Diagram
81:247.description: Architecture Diagram · best for Decision, Principle. Two labelled zones, one arrow, one annotation that carries the rule. Chips should be real components exported from the real file. Sample from postcard-wireframes.jsx.

81:262.name: Content/Pipeline
81:262.description: Pipeline · best for Teaching. Source → transform → output. The middle stage is one real terminal command. Highlight exactly one thing in the output. Sample from postcard-wireframes.jsx; replace with the real pipeline.

81:281.name: Content/Parity
81:281.description: Parity · best for Progress, Teaching. The same thing twice: Figma render left, live code render right, same zoom and crop. The = is the whole argument; any drift undermines the card. Replace both Specimens with real screenshots.

81:294.name: Content/Before After
81:294.description: Before / After · best for Failure. The mistake struck through with error ✕ on the left, the fix with primary ✓ on the right. Red only on the left, the brand accent only on the right; never mix. Equal visual weight. Sample from postcard-wireframes.jsx.

81:305.name: Content/Ledger
81:305.description: Ledger · best for Progress and recaps. A left-aligned checklist of real item names at uneven lengths, 6 lines at most. Subtraction variant: set rows to Struck=Yes for a ledger of what was cut. Sample rows are this library's own build, 2026-09-24.

266:320.name: Stamp and Postmark
266:320.description: The post type's stamp, cancelled (catalog: cachet). A perforated stamp in type/accent with the type's icon (Flag progress, Signpost decision, Skull failure, Sun principle, Bell teaching), its label and the 2¢ value from Entry 001-C; a ring postmark with the handle or series over the day or date, the card's topic glyph, and five machine waves. Ink is on-surface at 62%. Code adds speckled wear (an SVG noise mask) that Figma doesn't draw. 400×220. Edit the ring text on the curve directly (text on a path takes no component property). Sample: the figma-variables card. Dressing.tsx Cachet (@jkidd/ui).

266:343.name: Rubber Stamp
266:343.description: One verdict word the card itself says (catalog: rubber), boxed twice in type/ink at 80% and tilted 4–10°; the code sizes it 64 + 34px a letter by 92. Only when the card has a verdict. Code adds speckled wear that Figma doesn't draw. Sample: the link-page-weight card. Dressing.tsx RubberStamp (@jkidd/ui).

266:349.name: Divider Imprint
266:349.description: The divided back's centre rule (catalog: imprint), with the card's source printed up it like a publisher's number: IDEA <id> · JOURNAL <event>, in on-surface-variant at 70%. Only when the card has a source. Sample: the figma-variables card. Dressing.tsx Imprint (@jkidd/ui).

266:355.name: Registration Mark
266:355.description: A crosshair target, the printer's mark (catalog: registration): one in each corner, 24px in from the edges and the rail, in on-surface at 45%, for a build that runs through a press. Dressing.tsx Target (@jkidd/ui).

266:360.name: Colour Bar
266:360.description: The five post type accents as a printer's colour bar along the foot of the card (catalog: colorbar), centred 17px up: each swatch is type/accent fixed to its own Post Type mode, so it shows all five whatever the card's type. dressing.css .jk-back__colorbar (@jkidd/ui).

266:368.name: Photo Corner
266:368.description: Album corners on each zone, so two halves sit like mounted prints (catalog: corners): on-surface at 82%, set 6px out from the zone's corners. Parity cards. Dressing.tsx PhotoCorners (@jkidd/ui).

266:380.name: Airmail Edge
266:380.description: Bands of type/accent and on-surface chevrons along the top and bottom edges (catalog: airmail), 14px tall from the rail to the right edge, at 85%: one dispatch in a run, so only on series posts. Stretch it to the card's width; it clips. dressing.css .jk-back__airmail (@jkidd/ui).

266:388.name: Graph Paper
266:388.description: Graph paper (catalog: grid): a 24px minor grid at 9% and a 120px major grid at 20%, in type/accent, so it takes the card's Post Type mode; the stage postcards' paper. A texture: lay it over the stock, under the content, one per card. Resize it to the card (it clips; drawn to 1600×1350). Code: dressedpostcard.css [data-texture=grid].

266:394.name: Ledger Ruling
266:394.description: Ledger ruling (catalog: ledger): feint rules every 56px in on-surface at 9% and a double margin line at 96px and 104px in type/accent at 14%, left of the content. A texture for Ledger cards: lay it over the stock, under the content. Resize it to the card (it clips; drawn to 1600×1350). Code: dressedpostcard.css [data-texture=ledger].

266:482.name: Postcard/Manifesto
266:482.description: Manifesto archetype in the 16:9 constant frame. Default type: Principle (best for Principle). Shown as a 21 Days of Dev post. Change the type by setting this instance's Post Type mode; change the scheme with its Scheme mode.

266:484.name: Postcard/Architecture Diagram
266:484.description: Architecture Diagram archetype in the 16:9 constant frame. Default type: Decision (best for Decision, Principle). Shown as a 21 Days of Dev post. Change the type by setting this instance's Post Type mode; change the scheme with its Scheme mode.

266:486.name: Postcard/Pipeline
266:486.description: Pipeline archetype in the 16:9 constant frame. Default type: Teaching (best for Teaching). Shown as a regular post: day and series off. Change the type by setting this instance's Post Type mode; change the scheme with its Scheme mode.

266:488.name: Postcard/Parity
266:488.description: Parity archetype in the 16:9 constant frame. Default type: Progress (best for Progress, Teaching). Shown as a 21 Days of Dev post. Change the type by setting this instance's Post Type mode; change the scheme with its Scheme mode.

266:490.name: Postcard/Before After
266:490.description: Before After archetype in the 16:9 constant frame. Default type: Failure (best for Failure). Shown as a regular post: day and series off. Change the type by setting this instance's Post Type mode; change the scheme with its Scheme mode.

266:492.name: Postcard/Ledger
266:492.description: Ledger archetype in the 16:9 constant frame. Default type: Progress (best for Progress, recaps). Shown as a 21 Days of Dev post. Change the type by setting this instance's Post Type mode; change the scheme with its Scheme mode.

275:48.name: Picture Postcard
275:48.description: Picture postcard: one of the postcard's two types (the archetype Postcard/* are the other). A generated front (swap Front's image fill) in a cream mat (--jk-genre-picture-mat) and a 10px ink border, 1536×1024, scaled not reflowed. Live type on top: a title (Inter Black 148, cream, hard ink shadow) only on art-only fronts; a location ribbon; a story label tilted 2° in the bottom corner the hero isn't standing in (mirror to the left). With a title on, code moves the ribbon under the title. Ink, cream and ribbon are the front's series' own (--jk-genre-picture-<series>-*), shown here in Western with the orange ribbon; Dark Teal and Brown ribbons take cream text. Story and location copy is the library's own (STORY_STARTERS). Code: PicturePostcard (jkidd-ds, #/postcards).

266:820.name: Story Label (draft)

Story.default: SOMEONE PARKED ON THE MOON BUGGY

266:820.description: The picture postcard's story label. One of the postcard's two types (the archetypes are the other). Code: PicturePostcard in jkidd-ds (#/postcards).
